gloss: to go for tea; to hang out at a café

definitions.gloss: to go for tea; to have a coffee; to hang out at a café
definitions.explanation: To spend time at a café or tea shop, chatting over a drink. Casual spoken Japanese; the point is the socializing rather than the tea itself, so it covers coffee and cake just as well.

examples.japanese: ⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧お⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧しない?
⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友|とも}→友：03466_tomo⟧だち⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After shopping I had tea with a friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧なら、⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧し⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{話|はな}しません→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: If you have time, shall we talk over tea at the café in front of the station?

notes:
A casual suru-verb made from the everyday noun ⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧ (tea). The お is fixed here — ⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is not used.

USAGE:
Most often heard as an invitation: ⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧?, ⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧. It is too casual for business settings, where ⟦{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせ→打ち合わせ：07155_uchiawase⟧ or ⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{飲|の}みません→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ would be used instead. Common among friends and especially among younger speakers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧?: want to get tea?
- ⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have tea or something
- ⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{茶|ちゃ}する: to hang out at a café

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to drink tea — literal, about the drink rather than the outing
- ⟦{一服|いっぷく}する→一服する：30189_ippukusuru⟧: to take a break — a short rest, often alone
